summary: Global max lateness after a task window (seconds); a per-task max_visit_lateness overrides it.
range: Integer seconds (max tolerated lateness vs a task's window). Not-in-spec: non-negativity / exact rejection behavior (TBC).
businessRules: A task's own max_visit_lateness overrides this global value (C2).
Lateness within tolerance is feasible and surfaces as steps[].late_by and summary.total_visit_lateness; lateness beyond tolerance is infeasible (C2).

max_visit_lateness defines: This is a soft constraint for permissible delay, in seconds, to complete a job or shipment after its time window is over. If a job or shipment’s lateness exceeds this value, it will be considered a…
Must stay consistent with: jobs.max_visit_lateness, options.constraint.visit_lateness_penalty. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: a global tolerance (e.g. 600s) lets a slightly-late arrival still be served, surfacing late_by within tolerance (C2).
Positive: zero tolerance (0) with on-time arrival is served with no lateness (C2).
Boundary: arrival exactly at window-end + max_visit_lateness is accepted; beyond it is infeasible (C2).
Negative-infeasible: a window unreachable even within the tolerance -> task unassigned (time-window reason) (C2 example 2).
Interaction: a job carrying its own max_visit_lateness overrides this global value (C2).
Interaction: Infeasible: job window [09:00,09:30], max_visit_lateness 0, nearest vehicle arrives 09:45 -> unassigned.
Interaction: Interaction: a long wait for a late window pushes route end past the shift -> unassigned (couples with max-duration-distance-cap).
Interaction: Shipment: delivery window [09:00,09:30], max_visit_lateness 15, nearest vehicle arrives 09:40 -> accepted within lateness.
Interaction: Break: break time_windows [12:00,13:00], vehicle arrives 12:30 -> break scheduled at 12:30.
